About Power Marine Partners

The steady hand behind the transaction.

Buying or selling a vessel brings together brokers, buyers, sellers and a long list of documentation — often moving at different speeds. Power Marine Partners Inc. exists to bring order to that process.

We coordinate the transaction itself: preparing and organising documentation, keeping communication clear between all parties, and guiding each step towards a smooth, timely closing. Our role is simple to describe and exacting to deliver — nothing overlooked, nothing left to chance.

  • A single, organised point of coordination for every transaction
  • Documentation prepared and tracked with close attention to detail
  • Clear, professional communication with every party involved

How It Works

Four steps to a smooth close

A clear, orderly path from your first enquiry to a completed transaction.

01

Initial Enquiry

Tell us about the transaction. We listen first, then outline exactly what the process will involve.

02

Transaction Review

We review the details and documentation requirements, and agree a clear plan and timeline with all parties.

03

Documentation & Coordination

Paperwork is prepared and organised while we coordinate communication and keep every milestone on track.

04

Closing & Completion

Final items are confirmed, the closing is completed in order, and the transaction concludes — smoothly.

We support buyers, sellers and brokers involved in marine transactions. Brokers in particular use our coordination and documentation support to keep deals moving while they focus on their clients.

With a simple enquiry. Share the outline of your transaction and we will review what is involved, explain the documentation and steps required, and agree a clear plan before coordination begins.
